faq.title: Questions
faq.q1: Why does the return rate change my profit so much?
faq.a1: Every refused parcel costs you shipping, packaging and ad money — but brings no sale. Those losses are paid by your delivered orders. With 30% refused parcels, each delivered order carries almost half of a lost one.
faq.a2: The minimum ROAS your ads manager must show so your ads don’t lose money, once product costs, fees and returns are counted. Below it, the campaign costs you money even if it “looks” profitable.
faq.q3: Are my numbers saved or sent anywhere?
faq.a3: No. Everything is calculated in your browser. Your numbers only appear in the link if you choose to share it.
faq.a4: Yes. The calculator is free, forever. We also sell Google Sheets templates for sellers who want to track every order.
